Thanks for the clear recap and attachments — received both and skimmed the guide. A few quick answers from our side: 
- Current state: we use static API keys for internal services today, stored in our vault. We want to move to service accounts and short-lived tokens for external connections where possible.
- Rotation policy: security prefers short-lived tokens where feasible; if using API keys we typically require rotation every 90 days with automated rotation via our Vault.
- KMS: we use AWS KMS for envelope encryption; any integration should support a KMS-backed approach or allow us to manage keys on our side.
- Scopes: we'd like embeddings and reranking to be scoped separately; at a minimum separate API keys or scoped tokens.

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks for confirming the slot — invite sent for Thu 3/23 9am PT. Below are short answers to the technical questions and what we'll bring to the call.

Quick answers:
- Auth options: Redwood supports three primary server-to-server auth patterns: 1) Static API keys (rotatable) for simple integrations; 2) Service-account JWT assertions (signed JWT exchanged for short-lived access tokens); 3) OIDC / Client Credentials for federated identity flows. We can support AWS KMS-backed secrets or customer-managed keys for signing/rotation.
- Rotation best practices: we recommend short-lived tokens (TTL 1 hour) for high-risk/external connections, 30-90 day rotation for long-lived API keys depending on automation. For batch embedding jobs we typically issue scoped service-account tokens that are renewed automatically by a job-runner.
- Scopes & isolation: embeddings/reranker endpoints support scoped tokens. You can request separate scopes or distinct service accounts per workload; many customers use separate service accounts for embeddings vs model-inference to limit blast radius.
- Tool-calling / structured output: delegation scopes are supported; we recommend issuing limited-scope tokens to tool connectors and using our built-in auditing to trace calls.

What we'll bring to the workshop:
- Sample Node and Python SDK snippets for: API key use, JWT service-account flow, and token refresh code.
- A short runbook showing key rotation steps and recommended automation with HashiCorp Vault / AWS KMS.
- A proposed scope mapping template (we'll populate with recommended scopes for embeddings, rerank, and tool-calling).

Action items before the call:
- Alice/Bob: confirm the security contact (Bob confirmed) and any hard stop items from compliance (e.g., maximum key TTL), please reply in-thread if anything is missing.
- Marissa/Neha: we'll load the MMP with the above deliverables and attach the SDK snippets to the event.

Looking forward to it.
